css: .hook-player { left:940px; top:250px; width:800px; box-sizing:border-box; padding:28px } .hook-screen { height:280px; border-radius:12px; background:var(--shade); position:relative } .hook-play { position:absolute; left:50%; top:50%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); width:96px; height:96px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--main); color:var(--ground); font-size:38px; line-height:96px; text-align:center } .hook-controls { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:20px; margin-top:24px } .hook-dot { width:28px; height:28px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--main); flex:none } .hook-track { flex:1; height:12px; border-radius:6px; background:var(--hair); position:relative } .hook-fill { position:absolute; left:0; top:0; bottom:0; width:30%; border-radius:6px; background:var(--mute) } .hook-ccoff { font-size:26px; color:var(--accent); white-space:nowrap } .hook-addon { left:1500px; top:680px }
